mvp-poc-local-render/recap-and-environme.summary: Check you are ready for deploy: Todo Lab 6 done or planned; Ask IT assignment next.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: List anything blocking a POC: missing Docker, failing tests, unclear env vars. Tutor helps on Todo lab; Ask IT deploy is your assignment.

mvp-poc-local-render/development-vs-mvp-.summary: Plain definitions: dev on your laptop, POC for a small pilot URL, production for real users.

sections.heading: Three environments
sections.body:
- **Development:** fast changes on localhost (Todo labs, early Ask IT).
- **POC / MVP:** shared pilot URL (Render), limited users.
- **Production:** stricter secrets, monitoring, runbooks (Stage 8+).

mvp-poc-local-render/repeatable-local-ru.summary: Why Docker matters—and where Todo lab vs Ask IT assignment fit.

sections.heading: Ask IT (what the client needs)
sections.body: Pilot stores need the same stack everywhere: API, chat UI, database. Docker Compose is the standard way to run that stack.

sections.heading: Todo lab (where you learn)
sections.body: Open **Lab 6: Todo deploy** in this stage. You will practice local run, hello-world, compose, and Render POC on the **Todo** app with your tutor.

mvp-poc-local-render/render-poc-deployme.summary: Render hosting concepts—prompts live on Lab 6 (Todo) and the staging assignment (Ask IT).

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Render builds and runs your API and static site. Set `healthCheckPath`, build commands, and env vars in the dashboard.

- **Todo:** Lab 6 step 4 (with tutor)
- **Ask IT:** Assignment *Staging checklist and pilot plan* (on your own)

This read has **no** prompt panel—go to those items in the list.

mvp-poc-local-render/lab-6-poc-hardening.summary: Tutored lab: Todo — local, Docker, Render POC (four steps).

sections.heading: Prerequisites
sections.body: Development Labs 4–5 complete. Docker Desktop running. Open the **Lab** panel at the bottom of this page for prompts and checkpoints.

sections.heading: Then
sections.body: Do the **Ask IT** deploy assignment in this stage without your tutor.

mvp-poc-local-render/pilot-feedback-and-.summary: How to run three pilot sessions and turn feedback into a fix list.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: After Ask IT is on a POC URL, watch real users for 15–20 minutes each. Log: what broke, what confused them, what worked. Rank fixes by user impact.

mvp-poc-local-render/wrap-up-and-assignm.summary: Record deploy status and open questions before production stage.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Note Todo vs Ask IT URLs, known limits, and what you would harden next. Submit assignment evidence to your instructor.

mvp-poc-local-render/staging-checklist-a.summary: Assignment: Ask IT local → Docker → Render (solo).

sections.heading: Skills from Todo Lab 6
sections.body: Same sequence you did with your tutor—now for Ask IT in your repo. Prompts are in the **Assignment** panel at the bottom of this page.
